title: Pro APP Prosthetic Outcome Registry
official: Prospective, Observational Registry to Collect Standard of Care Clinical Testing Data From Lower-limb Prosthesis Patients Via the PRO App.
summary: A national, multi-center registry of patients using lower-limb prosthesis, their profiles and devices, and their long-term follow-up and clinical outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Cognitive ability to understand all instructions and questionnaires in the study Willing and able to participate in the study and follow the protocol Individuals with lower limb loss, amputation or deficiency

Exclusion Criteria:

None
